# JSON AI — Full Technical Documentation

This document contains the complete details, features, and usage guidelines for JSON AI (https://jsonai.online), a suite of 100% client-side developer utilities. It is designed for LLMs, AI agents, and search engines to ingest.

---

## 1. AI Assistant
- **URL**: https://jsonai.online/ai-assistant/
- **Description**: Secure, key-based UI to generate, explain, fix, transform, and schema-ify JSON using Google Gemini or OpenAI.
- **Privacy**: API keys are stored only in the browser's `localStorage` and never touch a backend server.
- **Prompting Features**: 
  - **Generate**: Create mock data from natural language descriptions.
  - **Explain**: Convert dense JSON structures into readable markdown explanations.
  - **Schema**: Auto-generate JSON Schemas.
  - **Fix**: Analyze and automatically repair malformed JSON payloads.
  - **Transform**: Convert fields, filter arrays, or translate structures via prompts.

## 2. JSON Formatter
- **URL**: https://jsonai.online/formatter/
- **Description**: Format, beautify, and sort JSON.
- **Key Features**:
  - Indentation choices: 2 spaces, 4 spaces, or Tabs.
  - **Auto-repair (Fix)**: Handles trailing commas, single-quoted strings, unquoted keys, Python/JS literals (`True`, `False`, `None`), and LLM code-fence boxes.
  - One-click copy, download, and file upload.
  - Ctrl+Enter shortcut to format.

## 3. JSON Validator
- **URL**: https://jsonai.online/validator/
- **Description**: Find precise syntax errors with line-level highlights.
- **Key Features**:
  - Real-time inline validator showing exact line and column numbers.
  - Human-friendly hints for syntax mistakes (e.g., "Use double quotes instead of single quotes").
  - Auto-Fix parser to repair formatting mistakes in one click.

## 4. Tree Viewer & Editor
- **URL**: https://jsonai.online/editor/
- **Description**: Visualise JSON structures as interactive collapsible trees.
- **Key Features**:
  - Add, edit, remove, and reorder key-value pairs inline.
  - Drag-and-drop hierarchy adjustments.
  - Instant conversion back to formatted JSON text.

## 5. JSON Converter
- **URL**: https://jsonai.online/converter/
- **Description**: Convert between data structure formats.
- **Key Features**:
  - Supports bi-directional conversions: JSON ↔ YAML, JSON ↔ CSV, JSON ↔ XML, JSON ↔ TOML.
  - Client-side execution ensures large data files are converted instantly without server latency.

## 6. JSON Diff
- **URL**: https://jsonai.online/diff/
- **Description**: Compare two JSON payloads side-by-side.
- **Key Features**:
  - Deep semantic comparison (reordered keys are not flagged as differences).
  - Colour-coded legend: Green (+) for added, Red (-) for removed, Yellow (~) for changed.

## 7. Schema Generator
- **URL**: https://jsonai.online/schema/
- **Description**: Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema generation.
- **Key Features**:
  - Auto-generates schemas with type detection, nested objects, and array boundaries.
  - Validation sandbox to test sample JSON against your generated schema.

## 8. Path Finder
- **URL**: https://jsonai.online/path-finder/
- **Description**: Query JSON trees using JSONPath query syntax.
- **Key Features**:
  - Interactive Tree: Click any node to instantly copy its JSONPath (e.g., `$.users[0].address.city`).
  - Evaluation box to test queries like `$.store.book[*].author`.

## 9. Type Generator
- **URL**: https://jsonai.online/type-generator/
- **Description**: Convert JSON to typed code formats.
- **Supported Outputs**: TypeScript Interfaces, Zod Schemas, Python Dataclasses, Go Structs, Rust Structs, and PHP Classes.

## 10. JSON Minifier
- **URL**: https://jsonai.online/minifier/
- **Description**: Strip spaces, tabs, and newlines to shrink JSON payload size.
- **LLM Benefits**: Reduces token usage by 50% to 75% when sending JSON configs to GPT or Claude APIs.

## 11. Escape Tool
- **URL**: https://jsonai.online/escape/
- **Description**: Escape or unescape string characters for safe storage/transmission.

## 12. Prompt Builder
- **URL**: https://jsonai.online/prompt-builder/
- **Description**: Convert verbose plain text system prompts into structured JSON objects to optimize prompt efficiency.
